svg.text: One-way pipeline: prices in at the top, risk numbers out at the bottom. Imports only flow downward.
log returns · r_p = Σ wᵢ rᵢ
forecast for day t uses data ≤ t−1
one RNG seed for all randomness
common date range, no silent ffill
risk/ · Estimator(window returns, weights, α) → (VaR, ES) as positive 1-day losses
The caller chooses the window, so no-look-ahead lives in one place (backtest/rolling.py). 10-day = 1-day × √10.
rolling.py — for day t: fit on rows [t−500, t−1],
compare with realised loss on day t
tests.py — Kupiec POF χ²(1) · Christoffersen χ²(1)

Each layer imports only from layers above it (enforced by an AST test). Layers 2–3 are pure functions: arrays in, numbers out.
